zh.about_lead: 想清楚，写下来，做出来，再分享出去。
zh.about_intro: 我早期做数据科学、机器学习和统计，写过四本关于 R 与统计分析的书；现在更感兴趣的是 AI、区块链、软件开发、商业与创业。方向在变，做事的方式没变：先把问题想明白，再用文字和作品讲清楚，最后公开出来。
strengths: 我花很多时间研究思考本身：怎样观察一个问题，怎样拆解结构，怎样做判断。这些想法被整理成《认知语言工程》，以及自我、人际、结构等系列。
四本已出版的书，加上 100 多本在线电子书，从 R 与统计，到 AI、架构与语言，持续更新。
把想法做成能用的东西。
原生 macOS 应用、本地工作流、设计系统图鉴……我自己做软件，也用 AI 编码工具把它们做出来，并把方法写成教程。
电子书在线阅读，项目代码公开在 GitHub，过程和方法也一并写出来，希望能帮到走在同一条路上的人。
zh.about_brand: LINTHESIS 是这些创作共用的署名：把思考、知识与技术，变成可用的作品。{en} {zh}

en.works_p: Software, tools and websites I have made. Each has its own write-up, screenshots and links.
en.books_p: Published print books, and online guides that keep growing.
en.writing_p: Long-form writing published online, grouped into series. Each link opens the matching online book. The books themselves are in Chinese.
en.writing_todo: Short essays and research notes: coming.
en.music_p: Songs and music videos made with AI. A small selection is here.
en.lab_p: Ideas, prototypes and experiments still being explored. They are at different stages, and most are still evolving.
en.about_lead: Think it through, write it down, build it, and share it.
en.about_intro: I started in data science, machine learning and statistics, and wrote four books on R and statistical analysis. What interests me now is AI, blockchain, software development, business and entrepreneurship. The subject has changed; the way I work has not: understand the problem first, explain it with words and with things that work, then put it out in the open.
strengths: I spend a lot of time studying thinking itself: how to look at a problem, take a structure apart, and make a judgment. Those ideas became Cognitive Language Engineering and the series on self, people and structure.
Four published books and more than a hundred online books, from R and statistics to AI, architecture and language, still growing.
Turn ideas into things that work.
Native macOS apps, local workflows, a visual index of design systems. I build the software myself, with AI coding tools, and write the method up as guides.
What I make, I put out in the open.
Books you can read online, code public on GitHub, and the process and method written down too, in the hope it helps others on the same road.
en.about_brand: LINTHESIS is the shared byline for all of this: turning thought, knowledge and technology into work that is usable. {en}
